title: Hitting probability recurrence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r$ be a decidable binary relation on $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and form the directed graph whose edges are given by $r$. If $s$ and $t$ are distinct vertices and $s$ has at least one outgoing neighbor, then for every $k\in\mathbb{N}$ the probability of hitting $t$ from $s$ after $k+1$ steps is the average of the probabilities after $k$ steps over all outgoing neighbors of $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The out-neighborhood of s has positive cardinality
